open_points.subject: show_port_refs
open_points.text: - show_port_refs: [FIELD_PROJECTION] For each PortRef, in order, MUST produce one ShownPort with the same port name and one ShownItem per referenced item in order: a StoredValuesRef reads its StoredValue records with read_records using RecordsById with when_missing internal_error, and a value carriage item becomes ShownContent with its value_id, its canonical JSON text read with read_value_bytes from a StoredValueSource and its class, a file carriage item becomes ShownFile with digest, size, media type, class, its value_id and no spooled_file; a file carriage StoredValue always has a media type, its fixture taking its port's one media type (decision 18), so one whose media_type is None is a record that cannot be read and raises StoreInternalError, propagating as the validation note says; a SpooledFilesRef reads its SpooledFile records with SpooledFilesByKey with when_missing internal_error and each becomes ShownFile carrying its full SpooledFileKey and no value_id; a FileFactsRef becomes one ShownFile per FileFacts with the class the FileFactsRef carries, no spooled_file and no value_id.
open_points.other_text: - show_port_refs: [BEHAVIOR] MUST call read_records only when a PortRef names at least one item, since read_records refuses an empty identity list as malformed: a SpooledFilesRef whose files are empty, a file list with no files, becomes a ShownPort with the same port name and no ShownItem, and makes no read.
open_points.question: Must an empty SpooledFilesRef read its SpooledFile records as the field-projection passage requires, or make no read as the behavior passage requires?
